column1: # The two sources this engine's committed answers come from.
# default is the grammar: Cosmos DB for NoSQL publishes its query language as
# sql.g4, and the parser's compat rows are judged against it. There is no image:
# the digest is the SHA-256 of testdata/sql.g4, which is Microsoft's file byte
# for byte, as the .NET SDK publishes it
# emulator is the server the driver's tapes replay. Cosmos DB for NoSQL has no
# server CI can start, and Azure publishes no image of one, so the driver's
# recordings come from Microsoft's classic Linux emulator: the one whose gateway
# refuses to merge a cross-partition query by itself, which is the behavior the
# query engine exists for. The vnext-preview emulator answers those queries out
# of PostgreSQL itself, so nothing would ever reach the engine. Only a recording
# starts it (one per machine, on the port it advertises), and upgrading the pin
# means recording every tape again and reading what moved.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
